# Keyboard shortcuts

Shortcuts aren't remappable in this version (PROMPT §2, locked). On macOS, Ctrl/⌘ in the app's own
menus becomes ⌘ — every table below shows both.

### General

| Action | Windows / Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|
| Play / pause | `Space` | `Space` |
| Play from start | `Shift+Space` | `⇧Space` |
| Return to start | `Home` | `Home` |
| Loop playback on/off | `Ctrl+L` | `⌘L` |
| Record (start/stop) — provisional binding | `Shift+R` | `⇧R` |
| Add marker | `M` | `M` |
| Undo | `Ctrl+Z` | `⌘Z` |
| Redo | `Ctrl+Shift+Z` | `⇧⌘Z` |
| Open | `Ctrl+O` | `⌘O` |
| Save | `Ctrl+S` | `⌘S` |
| Save As | `Ctrl+Shift+S` | `⇧⌘S` |
| Cut | `Ctrl+X` | `⌘X` |
| Copy | `Ctrl+C` | `⌘C` |
| Paste | `Ctrl+V` | `⌘V` |
| Delete selection | `Delete` | `Delete` |
| Trim to selection (Crop) | `Ctrl+T` | `⌘T` |
| Delete selected marker(s) | `Ctrl+0` | `⌘0` |
| Go to next marker | `Ctrl+Alt+→` | `⌥⌘→` |
| Go to previous marker | `Ctrl+Alt+←` | `⌥⌘←` |
| Capture Noise Print — provisional binding | `Shift+P` | `⇧P` |
| Show/hide the spectral pane | `Shift+D` | `⇧D` |

### Waveform view

| Action | Windows / Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|
| Zoom in (waveform) | `=` | `=` |
| Zoom out (waveform) | `-` | `-` |
| Zoom in (vertical) | `Alt+=` | `⌥=` |
| Zoom out (vertical) | `Alt+-` | `⌥-` |
| Reset vertical zoom | `Alt+0` | `⌥0` |
| Select all | `Ctrl+A` | `⌘A` |
| Clear selection | `Esc` | `Esc` |
| Nudge cursor/selection left | `←` | `←` |
| Nudge cursor/selection right | `→` | `→` |
| Extend selection left | `Shift+←` | `⇧←` |
| Extend selection right | `Shift+→` | `⇧→` |

Marked "provisional" above (Record (start/stop) — provisional binding, Capture Noise Print — provisional binding): these match Audition's default per the best
sources found so far (see `specs/SPEC-002-recording-monitoring.md` and
`specs/SPEC-014-noise-reduction.md`), but the canonical Adobe reference page
(`helpx.adobe.com/audition/desktop/keyboard-shortcuts/default-keyboard-shortcuts.html`) still
returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch (`docs/references.md`), so neither has an independent,
authoritative confirmation.

"Dialogs" and "Text fields" have no entries today — every dialog's own Escape/Enter handling is
local to that dialog, not a registry binding, and no shortcut is defined to fire *inside* a text
field beyond the browser's native editing keys. The scopes exist in the registry (`ShortcutScope`)
for when one is needed; see `ui/src/lib/shortcuts/registry.ts`'s doc comment for the dispatch
rule that keeps them conflict-free with "General"/"Waveform view" when that happens.
